name: Recycling Diversion and Capture Rates
description:
This dataset records municipal recycling performance by district and zone over fiscal months from 2016 through 2019. Each row represents one district's results for a given month and year, with 59 districts grouped into seven zones such as the Bronx, Manhattan, Brooklyn North, Brooklyn South, and Queens East. The data includes a diversion rate showing the share of total waste that was recycled, plus capture rates for paper, mixed paper (MGP), and leaves, each expressed as a percentage of the maximum amount that could have been recovered. A combined capture rate covering total recycling, leaves, paper, and MGP is also provided.

The data can be used to compare recycling performance across districts and zones, track changes over time, and spot areas with low capture rates that may need outreach or program adjustments. Because it spans multiple years and every month, it supports analysis of seasonal patterns such as leaf collection, evaluation of policy or program effects, and reporting against waste diversion goals.
